# Oyoto

> Oyoto (written Oyotō) is a UK digital product studio founded by software engineer James Mboma. It designs and builds web platforms, mobile apps, AI integrations and cloud systems for founders and teams.

## Core URLs

- Home: https://oyoto.co.uk/
- Projects: https://oyoto.co.uk/projects
- Resume: https://oyoto.co.uk/resume
- Contact: https://oyoto.co.uk/contact
- Sitemap: https://oyoto.co.uk/sitemap.xml

## Services

- Full-stack development
- Cloud architecture
- UI/UX engineering
- AI integration
- Mobile apps
- Business intelligence
- Technical consulting

## Case Studies

- [Trakr](https://oyoto.co.uk/projects/trakr): AI-driven career intelligence and application tracking, in closed beta.
- [Lloyds Banking Group](https://oyoto.co.uk/projects/lloyds-banking-group): data pipelines and AI summarisation behind senior leadership reporting.
- [Nike](https://oyoto.co.uk/projects/nike): recommender and classification models driving member engagement.
- [River Life Church](https://oyoto.co.uk/projects/river-life-church): website and self-managed content for a church family in Bulwell, Nottingham.
